fs-t.label: Rajasthan Royals' death-overs run rate, 2024–2026
fs-t.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fs-t.query: SELECT SUM(d.total_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 AND i.batting_team_id IN (10)

fs-n.label: IPL batters with at least 90 balls at the death, 2024–2026
fs-n.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fs-n.query: SELECT pl.name, MAX(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (10) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mine, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bnd, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 AND d.batter_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dots FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY pl.name
